name: ARN Smart URL Manager
author: arnsmart

sections.description:
ARN Smart URL Manager is a modern, lightweight, and scalable URL management system built for WordPress.

It goes beyond simple short links by providing a complete link workflow: creation, redirection, tracking, and URL review — all inside a clean and fast interface.

Whether you’re managing campaigns, improving user experience, or building link-in-bio pages, this plugin gives you full control over your URLs.

🚀 Core Features

🔗 Short Link Engine

Create clean, trackable short URLs in seconds with a structured and scalable system.

🔁 Smart Redirect System

Manage 301 and 302 redirects with precision and reliability.

📊 Lightweight Analytics

Track clicks and link performance without external services — fully local and privacy-friendly.

🛡️ URL Health Review

Review the URLs of your posts and pages for routing conflicts, duplicate risks, readability, and title alignment. Scans run in the background in small steps, so large sites are not checked in one long request.

📱 QR Code Generator

Generate QR codes (PNG) for your short links and custom content in QR Studio. Requires the PHP GD extension.

🌐 Bio Page Builder

Create simple and effective link-in-bio pages for social media profiles.

⚡ Why ARN Smart URL Manager?

  • Built for performance — lightweight and fast
  • Clean and modern admin interface
  • Works independently from WordPress permalinks
  • WordPress Multisite support with separate data for each site
  • No external services required
  • Includes Settings > ARN Free AI, the shared screen where ARN Free plugins that use AI get their provider, your own API key, model and usage limits; this plugin itself sends no AI requests

🔒 Privacy First

  • No external tracking
  • No API connections of its own; only the optional “Test connection” and “Load models” buttons of the shared Settings > ARN Free AI screen contact an AI provider, when an administrator clicks them (see External services)
  • All analytics stored locally in your WordPress database

⭐ Pro Version

ARN Smart Linkix is the Pro version, available on arnsmart.com. It uses the same data, so your links, redirects, QR settings, and analytics stay in place when you switch. It adds, among others:

  • Custom permalinks and canonical safety tools
  • Smart App Links with device-based app and store routing
  • Branded QR tools with SVG output
  • Broken link checks for redirects
  • Advanced analytics and reporting

The free version works on its own and does not require the Pro version or a license.

Learn more: https://arnsmart.com

External services

ARN Smart URL Manager does not send any site content to an AI provider and does not contact any ARN server. Links, redirects, QR codes and analytics work entirely on your own site.

ARN Free AI (Settings > ARN Free AI). The plugin bundles ARN Free AI, the shared AI settings screen of ARN Free plugins. Only when a site administrator chooses a provider on that screen and clicks “Test connection” (one short fixed test prompt, no site content) or “Load models” (the provider’s model list) is a request sent, with the administrator’s own API key, to that provider only, at that moment. The API key is stored encrypted in the WordPress database. No data is sent to any other provider.

  • OpenAI: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use , https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
  • Anthropic (Claude): https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms , https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Google Gemini: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms , https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • DeepSeek: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-terms-of-use.html , https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html
  • Moonshot AI (Kimi): https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/agreement/modeluse , https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/agreement/userprivacy
  • xAI (Grok): https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service , https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy
  • Mistral AI: https://legal.mistral.ai/terms , https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/privacy-policy
  • OpenAI-compatible endpoint: requests go to the address the administrator enters; that service’s own terms apply.

If WordPress AI is chosen instead, the test request goes through the provider connected in WordPress (Settings > Connectors) under that provider’s terms.

Other ARN Smart Products

  • ARN Smart Linkix — professional link operations with custom permalinks, canonical safety, smart routing, branded QR tools, and advanced analytics.
  • ARN Smart Visitor Intent — free visitor-intent capture, contact actions, consent tools, analytics, and CSV export.
  • ARN Smart Visioix — professional visitor and website intelligence, forms, automations, experiments, reporting, and AI-guided action planning.
  • ARN Smart Site Utilities for Elementor — free Elementor components and site utilities.
  • ARN Smart Image Optimizer — lightweight image optimization and modern image delivery for WordPress.

Learn more at https://arnsmart.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Open the ARN Smart Linkix menu (ARN Smart URL Manager) in your WordPress admin panel
sections.faq:
Does this plugin modify my existing WordPress URLs?

No. It works independently and does not modify your existing WordPress URLs.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. ARN Smart Linkix is the Pro version and is available on arnsmart.com. The free version is fully usable on its own.

Where is analytics data stored?

All analytics data is stored locally in your WordPress database.

Why does the URL Health scan show “running in the background”?

The scan runs through WP-Cron in short steps. If WP-Cron is disabled on your site (DISABLE_WP_CRON), make sure a server cron job calls wp-cron.php; otherwise the scan waits until WP-Cron runs.

What is removed when I delete the plugin?

Nothing, unless “Enable cleanup on uninstall” is on (Linkix settings, Maintenance tab). With it on, the plugin’s own data is removed (generated QR files only if “Also delete generated QR files” is on too); on a network every site follows its own choice, and sites where ARN Smart Linkix (Pro) is active are left untouched. The shared ARN Free AI settings, saved API keys and usage history of the cleaned sites are removed too, but only when no other installed ARN Free plugin (active or not) still uses them.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Fixed: redirect rules saved as “302 Temporary” answer with 302; before, every rule answered with 301.
  • Fixed: redirect rules saved as 302 in ARN Smart Linkix (Pro) stay 302 when the site uses ARN Smart URL Manager again.
  • Fixed: a redirect rule whose target is on another website goes to that website; before, the visitor was sent to the WordPress admin address instead.
  • Fixed: when ARN Smart Linkix (Pro) is installed as well, ARN Smart URL Manager no longer stops the site with a PHP fatal error. With Linkix Pro 2.0.1 or later it keeps running until the Linkix licence is active; Linkix then takes over with the same data.
  • Fixed: after creating or regenerating a short link, the editor URL panel no longer shows a Custom Permalink field that the free plugin does not support.
  • Fixed: the Copy button of the editor URL panel shows its result message also right after the page loads.
  • Fixed: on screens up to 960 pixels wide the admin header, the small statistics and the QR download form stack as designed; on phones the header text is no longer cut off. A broken style rule had switched these off and also limited the short link form to two columns on wide screens.
  • Fixed: PHP 8.1 and later no longer write “Implicit conversion from float” notices when a QR code needs more than one error correction block (for example a long bio page address).
  • Fixed: On a multisite network, ARN Smart URL Manager sets up a new site through the wp_initialize_site hook, after WordPress has created the site’s tables, instead of the deprecated wpmu_new_blog hook, so adding a site no longer logs a deprecation notice.
  • Fixed: Kimi models that always think (kimi-k2.7-code, kimi-k2-thinking, kimi-k3) no longer receive the “thinking disabled” setting they reject. The bundled ARN Free AI module is updated to 1.0.2.
  • Fixed: “Generate QR output automatically when a shortlink exists” works: when it is on, a new short link gets its QR image right away in the admin; when it is off, QR images are drawn only by downloads, bulk actions and the QR maintenance tools. Visitor requests never draw QR images.
  • Fixed: The QR maintenance tools of the Short Links screen cover every short link, not only the newest 200, and run in short background steps; the screen shows the progress and the result. “Cleanup orphan QR files” keeps every file a short link, QR Studio item or Bio page uses.
  • Fixed: The short link cards and the editor URL panel show the 512 px QR file the downloads use, and the cards fill in “QR Exists”, “Format”, “Print Ready” and “Last Generated”.
  • Fixed: With the “Plain” permalink structure, short links and Bio pages use query addresses (for example ?linkix_slug=abc12), so they open on every web server instead of showing the front page.
  • Changed: The short slug of the Short Links form is optional; an empty slug gets a random 5-character slug.
  • Bio page view and click counters are kept in their own table and updated with a single atomic query; a visit no longer rewrites the bio page settings, and simultaneous visits are no longer lost. Existing counts move to the new table on the first request after the update.
  • 404 entries are limited to 30 per visitor every 10 minutes (with raw logging on), so requests to random addresses can no longer fill the analytics tables.
  • Requests for /favicon.ico and /robots.txt no longer look up redirect rules.
  • Database table checks no longer run on visitor, AJAX, or REST requests: after an update the tables are checked once, and the regular check runs only on admin pages and scheduled tasks.
  • The admin header logo has a white background and is loaded again after each update.

1.1.0

  • New: Settings > ARN Free AI, the shared AI connection screen of ARN Free plugins (provider, your own API key stored encrypted, model, prices, usage and monthly limits). ARN Smart URL Manager itself sends no AI requests.
  • Fixed: a Bio page button or social icon that links to another site took the visitor to the WordPress login screen instead of that site. A click now goes to the link saved for it on that page, and a link without its address opens the saved link at its position.
  • Security: a Bio click goes only to one of the links saved on that page; any other address in the link is ignored.
  • Fixed: redirects now also work when WordPress has no page at the source path, such as the old address of a deleted page; before, only paths that still opened something were redirected.
  • Fixed: the bulk QR actions of the Short Links screen (generate, regenerate, PNG export) use the selected short links again; before, they always answered “No shortlinks were selected”.
  • Fixed: saving or deleting the Bio page returns to the Bio page screen with its notice; before, the screen stopped empty and a “headers already sent” PHP warning was logged.
  • Fixed: QR generation no longer tries to write a cache into the plugin folder, which wrote PHP warnings for every QR code.
  • PHP 8.5: drawing QR images no longer writes “imagedestroy() is deprecated” notices to the PHP error log.
  • Analytics counters are now written with a single atomic query, so simultaneous hits are no longer lost.
  • Unique hits now count the first visit of a visitor to the same link within 24 hours.
  • Bot and crawler requests are no longer recorded as 404 entries.
  • Raw click logs and 404 path statistics now follow the analytics retention period (90 days by default) and are removed in small batches; per-link click totals are kept. The Dashboard “Clicks” card shows the all-time total from the short link, redirect and bio page counters.
  • Old analytics events are removed in small batches instead of one large delete.
  • Bio page view and click counters no longer overwrite newer bio page edits.
  • URL Health scans now run in the background in small steps (WP-Cron) instead of one long admin request.
  • Database table checks no longer run on every request; plugin files load only when needed, and admin code no longer loads for unrelated AJAX requests.
  • Hardened the editor URL panel against HTML injection.
  • Uninstall with data cleanup now also removes bio pages, custom QR items, and the plugin’s remaining options; “delete QR files” also removes bio page and custom QR images and the emptied uploads/linkix folder.
  • Uninstall on multisite cleans every site according to that site’s own cleanup choice, and leaves sites where ARN Smart Linkix (Pro) is active untouched.
  • Uninstall: when “Enable cleanup on uninstall” is on and no other ARN Free plugin is installed, the shared ARN Free AI settings and usage of the cleaned sites are removed as well.

1.0.4

  • Declared and reviewed compatibility with WordPress 7.1.
  • Added matching WordPress requirements to the plugin header and readme.
  • Fixed network activation so all sites are processed in bounded batches.
  • Standardized the installable plugin folder and ARN Smart product discovery section.

1.0.3

  • Tested compatibility with WordPress 7.0
  • Improvements for the updated WordPress admin interface
  • Minor stability and UI consistency improvements

1.0.2

  • Fixed: Shortlink creation issues in WordPress Multisite environments
  • Fixed: Missing database tables on sub-sites causing functionality failures
  • Fixed: Redirect issues with external URLs
  • Fixed: “Headers already sent” warnings across admin actions and forms
  • Fixed: Settings not saving due to validation and form handling issues
  • Fixed: QR generation issues and cache directory handling

  • Fixed: Bulk actions and select-all checkbox behavior

  • Improved: Multisite compatibility across all core features

  • Improved: Plugin activation and database initialization process
  • Improved: Rewrite and redirect handling stability
  • Improved: Admin request handling using admin-post.php

  • Improved: QR storage system using WordPress uploads directory

  • Security: Replaced wp_redirect() with wp_safe_redirect()

  • Security: Added allowed redirect hosts validation

  • Security: Improved nonce handling for admin actions

  • Dev: Replaced unlink() with wp_delete_file()

  • Dev: Added caching layer for schema checks

  • Dev: Cleaned up Plugin Check (PHPCS) warnings and standards compliance

  • Minor: General stability, performance, and UI consistency improvements

1.0.1

  • Improved readme structure and content clarity
  • Optimized plugin tags for better discoverability

1.0.0

  • Initial release
